thread:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT detected — sudden spike to /v1/embeddings from APAC IP cluster (rate x15) — auto-threshold hit, paging oncall
Priya: I'm on it. checking kinesis/edge metrics now.
Liam: seeing huge fanout from a handful of proxies, same UA, short sessions. looks like a scraper farm.
Jules: any customer-facing impact yet? CX reports one user complaining about 429s.
Marco: confirmed one premium customer reported degraded throughput for embedding jobs around 03:14 UTC. ticket #CS-4821.
Priya: mitigation plan: 1) apply temporary rate-slice on embeddings route for APAC 2) enable WAF signature to block known proxy ASN 3) hold batching endpoints if needed.
Sahil: +1 to quick rate-slice. recommend 5 requests/min per IP for /v1/embeddings, keep other routes normal. We should avoid full disable.
Anna: rolling the rate limit via api-gw policy now:
```
route: /v1/embeddings
match: region=apac
rate_limit: 5rpm
quota_slice: true
```
Anna: applying in 30s (staged 3 nodes -> 50% -> 100%).
Liam: WAF rule ready to deploy, signature id 7882 — it blocks cf-proxy header combos we've seen. deploy in 60s after rate-slice stabilizes.
Priya: monitoring errors and 429 shape. If customer impact > 3 distinct accounts escalate.
Marco: pinging affected customer with a proactive note: "We're seeing high traffic affecting embeddings; implementing mitigations, you may see transient 429s, we'll follow up." sending now.
Marco: sent. customer replied: "Thanks — not critical but keep us posted."
Sahil: handoff note for next oncall (Liam at 05:00 UTC): watch for increased 5xx after WAF deploy, and rollback signature if false positives. I'll stay until 04:30.
Liam: acknowledged. I'll take at 05:00.
Priya: after 4m, APAC embeddings traffic down to baseline x1.3 and 429s dropped 90%. CPU and queue depth back to normal.
Anna: WAF signature rolled at 03:20, no customer 5xx spikes in metrics.
Jules: product note: pausing short-lived canary for embeddings batching until tomorrow — risk profile increased.
Priya: creating runbook entry and postmortem stub: actions taken, timestamps, metrics, customer ticket refs.
Priya: runbook excerpt added to incident doc: "If scraper fanout detected -> rate-slice by region -> deploy WAF signature -> monitor for false positives -> notify customers -> escalate to infra if backend latencies persist."
Marco: CS will follow up with impacted customer in morning and offer a temporary quota bump if they had critical jobs.
Sahil: final operational status: mitigations active, traffic normalized, no ongoing attacker IP growth. leaving oncall but reachable for questions.
Liam: will validate logs for any missed unique customers and remove temporary rules at 09:00 if stable.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT: mitigations applied, status = monitoring.
